verdict.rationale: A GlitchTip release note headlines "Merge issue support" (glitchtip-docs-53), so merging duplicate issues is a first-party capability, though it is evidenced only by a one-line blog summary. Nothing shows unmerging or splitting issues the fingerprinter wrongly collapsed. The 3.3.0 "issue fingerprint grouping" note (glitchtip-docs-55) concerns how grouping works, not manually splitting groups. Missing for 10: any split/unmerge capability, in-depth docs on the merge workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
